about: The Lab's core-medicine course, in teaching order. The daily pipeline builds the first module that is neither shipped (in lab/apps.json) nor withdrawn (in lab/rejected.json). Reorder, add or remove modules by editing this list; never change the slug of a shipped lesson. drugClasses are the drug classes and disease states each lesson animates (never doses).

modules.title: The Pressure–Volume Loop
modules.description: How one heartbeat fills and empties the left ventricle, drawn as a loop, and how fluids, blood pressure and heart drugs reshape it.
drugClasses: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

modules.title: The Nephron and Diuretics
modules.description: Follow salt and water along a nephron, segment by segment, and see where each diuretic blocks salt reabsorption and how much water follows it out.
modules.notes: Loop diuretic step: show Na+ leaving the nephron in the urine and blood volume dropping.

modules.title: Frank–Starling and Cardiac Output
modules.description: Why a fuller heart pumps harder, and how filling, heart rate and contraction strength add up to cardiac output.

modules.title: Blood Pressure Regulation
modules.description: Blood pressure as flow times resistance, and how the baroreflex keeps it steady from one moment to the next.

modules.title: The Renin–Angiotensin–Aldosterone System
modules.description: The hormone chain the kidney uses to raise blood pressure and hold on to salt, and the drugs that cut it at each link.

modules.title: The Autonomic Synapse
modules.description: How sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves talk to organs through receptors, and how drugs mimic or block that signal.

modules.title: The Cardiac Action Potential
modules.description: The ion currents behind each heartbeat, in pacemaker and muscle cells, and how antiarrhythmic drugs change their shape.

modules.title: The Neuromuscular Junction
modules.description: How a nerve signal becomes a muscle contraction, and how paralytic and reversal drugs act at the junction.

modules.title: Oxygen and Hemoglobin
modules.description: Why hemoglobin grabs oxygen in the lungs and lets go in the tissues, drawn as the dissociation curve, and what shifts it.

modules.title: Ventilation, Perfusion and the Alveolus
modules.description: How air and blood meet in the lung, and what happens to oxygen when the two are mismatched.

modules.title: Acid–Base Balance
modules.description: The bicarbonate buffer, the lungs and the kidneys working together to hold blood pH steady, and the four ways it goes wrong.

modules.title: The Coagulation Cascade
modules.description: How a clot is built, from platelet plug to fibrin mesh, and where each anticoagulant and clot-busting drug acts.

modules.title: Insulin and Glucose
modules.description: How insulin moves glucose out of the blood after a meal, what fails in diabetes, and how each diabetes drug helps.

modules.title: The Thyroid Axis
modules.description: The brain-to-thyroid feedback loop that sets the body's metabolic pace, and the drugs that replace or suppress thyroid hormone.

modules.title: The HPA Axis and Steroids
modules.description: How the brain and adrenal glands control cortisol through feedback, and why steroid drugs switch the axis off.

modules.title: Stomach Acid and the Parietal Cell
modules.description: How one stomach cell pumps acid on command, and how acid-reducing drugs turn it down at different steps.

modules.title: Pharmacokinetics: Drug Levels Over Time
modules.description: How a drug's level rises, plateaus and falls in the blood: absorption, distribution, half-life and steady state, drawn as curves.

modules.title: Inflammation and the Arachidonic Acid Pathway
modules.description: How injured cells make prostaglandins and leukotrienes, and where anti-inflammatory drugs block the pathway.

modules.title: The Bacterial Cell and Antibiotic Targets
modules.description: A tour of a bacterium's wall, ribosomes and DNA machinery, and the antibiotic families that attack each one.

modules.title: The Immune Response
modules.description: How the body recognises an invader, from the first innate response to antibodies and memory, and how immune drugs steer it.

modules.title: The Cell Cycle and Chemotherapy
modules.description: How a cell copies itself, phase by phase, and which chemotherapy drugs strike at which phase.
